policy_clauses.text: R1. Verify before you block on a weak signal.
R2. Customer denies the transaction: block card and create case.
R5. Card testing: three or more small authorizations then a larger purchase.

typologies.name: Card testing
typologies.indicators: three or more tiny online authorizations then a larger purchase

typologies.name: Out-of-region use
typologies.indicators: card-present purchases in a billing region with no history

typologies.name: Account takeover
typologies.indicators: mixed-channel activity inconsistent with the cardholder
